CRED Wallet Card Morph

Animation·by CRED·2026-09-04·60fps page·original post

What it is

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED's wallet unlock morph - after authentication (green ring in the Dynamic Island area), the hero panel fills with a glossy black card shown in extreme perspective; the card rotates and folds like liquid metal, a white card slides in reading "you've unlocked access to CRED WALLET", then the view settles back to the card face with "make payments with a single click".

Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: CRED's wallet unlock morph - after authentication (green ring in the Dynamic Island area), the hero panel fills with a glossy black card shown in extreme perspective; the card rotates and folds like liquid metal, a white card slides in reading "you've unlocked access to CRED WALLET", then the view settles back to the card face with "make payments with a single click".

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark CRED wallet screen (top pill with cashback status, hero panel, list rows below with "₹1,50,000" and "setup now"). The hero panel hosts the sequence: perspective card shot, morph, white unlock card, back to the card face.

## Motion spec
Pattern: 3D card morph with interstitial message card.
- Auth completes: a green ring flashes at the top (stroke, 300ms) as the hero panel crossfades to the card visual.
- The card appears in extreme foreshortening and rotates through a liquid fold (continuous rotation, ~1.2s, ease-in-out) with studio reflections sliding across its surface.
- A white card slides up over the panel (spring ~320/24) with serif copy "you've unlocked access to" + CRED WALLET logo; holds ~1s; slides away.
- The panel returns to the card's face view with overlaid copy "make payments with a single click" fading in (250ms).

## Calibration
- The card is near-black with white specular streaks - the shine sells the material, not the color.
- The white message card is the only bright element in the sequence; keep everything else dark.

## Reduced motion
Crossfade: card visual -> white message card -> card face (250ms each), no 3D fold.

## Don't miss
- The fold reads as one continuous rotation, not separate flips.
- Background rows (₹1,50,000, setup now) stay put throughout - only the hero panel animates.
